name: Deposito Mandiri
note: Declared by the client but never opened: the legacy code has no unit expansion and no leaves.

name: Deposito BRI
note: Declared by the client but never opened: the legacy code has no unit expansion and no leaves.

name: Deposito BNI
note: Declared by the client but never opened: the legacy code has no unit expansion and no leaves.

name: Setoran Dalam Perjalanan
note: OURS, not the client's — 0253 marks it. Not a fifth meaning: this is the rung 0247 had to mint so that 1011005001 Setoran Dalam Perjalanan could hang off a seven-digit family like every other posting. It is named after its only child because inventing a second name would be a second authority.

name: Setoran Dalam Perjalanan
note: OURS, not the client's — 0253 marks it. NEW. The daily deposit is a two-date document (money leaves the drawer today, lands at the bank when the bank says so). The client chart has no account for the gap; without one the second date cannot be booked.

name: Piutang QRIS
note: OURS, not the client's — 0253 marks it. NEW. Ours, not theirs: the client's chart has no QRIS account and cannot — it is older than QRIS. 0238 minted it, 0244 folded it onto Piutang Kartu Debit because this fixture (read before 0238 existed) had nowhere for it, and 0248 gives it back. A QRIS acquirer settles on a different rail, on a different day, at a different MDR and against a different statement, so it reconciles against an account of its own or against nothing. On the owner-approval list in coa-final.md §8.7.

name: Piutang Tender Lain-Lain
note: OURS, not the client's — 0253 marks it. NEW. Ours, not theirs, and for the same reason as Piutang QRIS beside it. There is no TRANSFER tender, so a counter transfer reaches the till as OTHER; money nobody has named stays visible here until somebody names it. On the owner-approval list in coa-final.md §8.7.

name: Cadangan Piutang Tak Tertagih
note: Three legacy allowances (credit card, debit card, employee) become one. Two of the three sat against card settlements that clear in two days and can never go bad.

name: Persediaan Perlengkapan Toko
note: Ten legacy accounts, one per shopping-bag SKU (plastic/paper x five sizes). The SKU split belongs to the inventory ledger.

name: Barang Dalam Perjalanan — Barang Dagangan
note: Carries counterparty_unit: the other end of the shipment. Must tie to the inventory ledger's in-transit pool.

name: Cadangan Kerusakan Persediaan
name_en: Allowance for inventory damage and loss

name: Sewa Dibayar Dimuka
note: Land, shop, staff house and vehicle rent were four prepaid accounts. The split is recovered when each amortises to its own rent expense account.

name: Rekening Koran Antar-Unit
note: ONE signed account carrying unit and counterparty_unit. Replaces 6 x 14 x 14 = 1,176 legacy leaves. Must sum to zero across all units; presented gross by sign on a unit report and dropped from the consolidated report.

name: Operating Equipment
note: Thirty-six legacy accounts, one per rack / mannequin / hanger type. That breakdown is the asset register's job; the GL needs the class total.

name: Aset Dalam Pengerjaan (CIP)
note: Re-parented: the client filed CIP under Other Assets (103). It is a fixed asset awaiting capitalisation.

name: Cadangan Penggantian Operating Equipment
note: The client reserves for OE replacement instead of depreciating it. Kept as its own contra, collapsed from 36.

name: Giro Keluar Belum Cair
note: Five per-bank outstanding-giro accounts plus the off-ladder 204001 become one clearing account. A post-dated cheque is a clearing position, not a bank balance; the bank it is drawn on is on the cheque.

name: Accrued Expense (Biaya Yang Masih Harus Dibayar)
Hutang kepada Pemilik
note: A matrix family that is not a matrix. 2012303 carries a 14-unit counterparty axis, but the counterparty is the PRINCIPAL, not a unit; 196 cells encode 14 facts.

name: Uang Muka Penjualan & Voucher
note: Company-wide on purpose: a voucher sold at one store is redeemable at any store, so the liability is the chain's, not the selling store's.

name: Pinjaman Jatuh Tempo Dalam Satu Tahun
Pinjaman Jatuh Tempo — Bank
note: Five per-bank accounts collapse to one. A loan is a contract with a schedule; the schedule and the lender belong to a loan register, not to five GL accounts.

name: Modal Disetor
note: Company-wide. 'Modal Setor C007' is fiction: a store has no share capital, only funding from head office, which is the inter-unit current account. OWNER DECISION: if the 14 units are separate legal entities, flip this account and the next three to dimension=unit; nothing else in the chart changes.

name: Penjualan Barang Dagangan
note: Nine legacy accounts split revenue by how the customer paid (cash, debit per bank, VISA, Mastercard, own web, marketplace). Tender is a property of the settlement, not of the sale; it already lands on the receivable side.

name: Management Fee
note: Head office charges the stores. Under one legal entity it eliminates against 7-3004.

name: Pendapatan Bunga Bank
note: Re-parented out of the expense root 8.

name: Potongan Pembelian
note: Re-parented out of root 8. Arguably belongs as a contra to cost of goods sold; kept as other income to match the client's presentation.

name: Pendapatan Sewa
note: Re-parented out of root 8.

name: Pendapatan Lain-lain
note: Absorbs the off-ladder 600104 'Pendapatan lain-lain', an income account the client parked under the expense root 6.

name: Gaji & Upah
note: One meaning, two legacy accounts: BIAYA PEGAWAI OPERATION and BEBAN PEGAWAI OFFICE. The only difference is whether the employee works in a store or the office, which is the unit.

name: Biaya Bank
note: The legacy template is named 'Biaya Bank HO' although it is expanded across all 14 units, so the chart contains 'Biaya Bank HO C001'.

name: Biaya Amortisasi Intangible Asset and Other Asset
Pajak Reklame
note: Legacy code 7020310003 hangs off a rung-5 group 70203 that does not exist; it should have been 7010310003.

name: Selisih Kas
note: OURS, not the client's — 0253 marks it. NEW. A physical drawer count produces a difference that needs a home; the client chart has none, and migration 0216 leaves the account to be chosen at posting time.
